name: Equipment and Plant Design
description: Introduction to plant design; design and operation of heat exchangers including shell and tube heat exchangers, and double pipe heat exchangers; principles of heat exchanger network design; mass transfer equipment; principles of phase equilibrium and their crucial roles in designing separation processes; fractional and catalytic distillation; absorption columns; liquid-liquid extraction columns; study of internals in packed and tray columns and design and operation of sieve trays, valve trays, bubble cap trays; types of packing materials in packed columns and their applications; plant layout design and flowsheeting using an appropriate software; process pipe sizing along with valves, fitting, instrumentation, and process flow diagram; rotating equipment selection (pumps, blowers, compressors, etc.); preparation of equipment specification sheets; development of piping and instrumentation diagrams.
